description: Price a selection of packages and add-ons for one service: one-time and recurring totals, tax and the grand total. Selections map a list_packages step slug to the item ids chosen on that step. Reports required steps left without a choice.

flags.description: Answers to the conditions some package steps depend on, as list_packages reports them, e.g. {"requires_virtual_office": true} when the customer has no business address of their own.

flow.description: The service: "incorporation-sdn-bhd" registers a new Sdn Bhd; "switch-in-sdn-bhd" moves an existing Sdn Bhd to this firm as its company secretary. get_firm_overview lists what this firm offers.

interval.description: Billing interval for steps that offer a choice. Defaults to each step's own default.

selections.description: Step slug → item ids from list_packages, e.g. {"package": ["pri_abc123"]}.

name: estimate_quote
title: Estimate a quote
